title: Controlled state preparation
description: Change control prepares attributable baseline action, transition and retirement content while preserving actual authority, custody and execution boundaries.

operations.name: prepare_controlled_state_action
operations.purpose: Prepare scoped authority, baseline transition or retirement content for an explicit state-control request.
inputs: Identified action, project/Change, participant, exact state/subjects and scope; selected policy and attributable existing grants with current conditions.
Supplied immutable baseline descriptors, actual effect observations, decision/provenance, or retirement inventory with complete reliance/recovery dispositions as appropriate.
Selected operational record read and intended retention contract where the participant requests recording.
Retirement executor, complete relevant writer/dependency scope and proposed or actually established cross-custody maintenance interval.
preconditions: The selected project, exact subject and requested scope are identifiable; missing required support is an explicit gap, not an assumed favorable result.
outputs: Exact prepared action/transition/disposition content, applicable authority scope and unresolved conditions; incomplete/unsupported result when required context is missing.
behavior: Apply MOD-017 state-control.md under MOD-006 responsibility; reuse existing FUNC-026 authority interpretation and preserve IF-009 policy meaning.
Keep actual grants, conformance, accountable decisions, confirmed custody and observed execution distinct; preparation creates none of them.
For an established transition require confirmed before/result baseline and observed adopted outcome with decision basis; otherwise retain proposed/incomplete meaning.
For retirement account for current dependencies, preserved history versus disposable detail, exact expected state, recoverability where required and actual effects.

MOD-005 consumes the action basis before baseline operations; MOD-012 carries actor-selected content through IF-004 and interprets actual retention. Changed semantic content or material basis requires fresh preparation.

Identify the stable maintenance scope required across model, operational, external-file/replacement and authority writers. Prepared readiness is not held exclusion: the executor must establish quiescence before final checks and hold it through effects/reconciliation, or withhold removal. Lost custody requires blocked-scope handoff and explicit recovery before resumption.

failure_behavior.condition: Policy, authority, required observation, baseline or reliance context is missing, conflicting or stale.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return affected gap and withhold favorable readiness/established-transition meaning; do not invent permission or executed effects.

failure_behavior.condition: Recording or material effects are partial or uncertain.
failure_behavior.outcome: Preserve known effects and require exact readback/reconciliation; preparation cannot claim saved content or authorize blind replay.

consistency_rules: MOD-006 supplies semantic preparation; MOD-005 consumes baseline action support, and MOD-012 arranges explicit recording through existing Operations.
The selected project policy controls decisions. Existing standing grants remain usable within scope; no universal approval gate or authority token is created.
Operational Basis and engineering Baseline retain different meanings; supporting attachments do not create a new native record type.
compatibility_rules: Logical participant-assisted contract only; existing v2/v4 fields and retained exact supporting attachments carry content without schema migration or new CLI commands.
SR006007 and operational maintenance duties retain their existing owners and scope; this contract does not complete those requirements.

sources.basis: Define immutable baseline custody, original-meaning comparison/recovery, attributable transition preparation and dependency-safe retirement. Preserve selective retention and separate action authority, operational maintenance and actual execution; proposed Design only.
